lines.t: Verse 1
I thought I had it figured out
Standing tall without a doubt
Blinded by my pride, I couldn’t see
What was right in front of me
You were calling, I turned away
Closed my ears to what You’d say
I locked the truth and kept the key
While You waited patiently
Chorus
Through a voice I couldn’t ignore
You exposed me to the core
Cut me deeper than before
Left me trembling on the floor
And the weight came crashing in
Every hidden, buried sin
I broke down, I couldn’t hide
Face to face with all my pride
Verse 2
Complacent in my walk with You
Idle heart that drifted from truth
Even when Your love came near
I refused the words I’d hear
Conviction gripped my heart
Tore my self-defense apart
Till it brought me to my knees
And revealed my desperate need
Bridge (crescendo)
No more masks, no holding back
No more choosing my own path
I lay down what I concealed
Every part I would not yield
Here I am, I come undone
Let Your will in me be done
Meet me in this broken place
Hold me in Your steady grace
Final Chorus
Through a voice I couldn’t ignore
You exposed me to the core
And the weight fell from my soul
When I let go of control
What I carried, I release
You have filled that space with peace
Now I’m leaving all behind—
No going back, no compromise
